name: check
title: Mantis check
description: A self-check an AI agent runs inside its app after changing UI: lists every place the code stepped outside Mantis (stock Tailwind colors, raw color values, bracket values where a token or scale step exists, numeric durations and stock blur sizes, source-layer tokens, Radix habits, another icon set, a theme that is not wired in), each with the fix to write. One file with no dependencies, generated from the token source.

files.content:

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ files
const SKIP_DIRS = new Set(['node_modules', '.next', 'dist', 'build', 'out', 'storybook-static', 'public', '.git', 'coverage'])
const EXTS = new Set(['.tsx', '.jsx', '.ts', '.js', '.mdx', '.html', '.css'])
// Never scan the check itself (its fix strings look like classes).
const SELF = /(^|[\\/])mantis-check(\.template)?\.mjs$/

export function listFiles(root, { dirs = [root], includeUi = false } = {}) {
  const out = []
  const walk = (dir) => {
    for (const name of readdirSync(dir).sort()) {
      const path = join(dir, name)
      if (statSync(path).isDirectory()) {
        if (SKIP_DIRS.has(name)) continue
        // The installed primitives hold Mantis's own measured values and are never edited: not the agent's code.
        if (!includeUi && name === 'ui' && /(^|[\\/])components$/.test(dir)) continue
        walk(path)
      } else if (EXTS.has(extname(name)) && !name.endsWith('.d.ts') && !SELF.test(path)) out.push(path)
    }
  }
  for (const dir of dirs) if (existsSync(dir)) walk(dir)
  return out
}

// A size token only has CSS if the app's copy of the theme defines it. An app that updates a
// component but not the theme gets a class with no CSS, and the control collapses without an error.
// components/ui is scanned whatever --include-ui says: an updated primitive is what outruns the theme.
// Each name maps to the theme key that gives it CSS: h-control needs --height-control (max-h reads the
// height keys too), and a stylesheet's var(--size-control) needs the runtime --size-control.
const SIZE_FAMILIES = { w: 'width', h: 'height', size: 'size', 'min-w': 'min-width', 'min-h': 'min-height', 'max-h': 'height' }
const SIZE_KEYS = Object.keys(DATA.sizes).join('|')
const SIZE_CLASS = new RegExp(`^(${Object.keys(SIZE_FAMILIES).join('|')})-(${SIZE_KEYS})$`)
const SIZE_VAR = new RegExp(`var\\(--size-(${SIZE_KEYS})\\)`, 'g')
export function sizeClassesIn(cwd) {
  const seen = new Map()
  for (const path of listFiles(cwd, { includeUi: true })) {
    const text = readFileSync(path, 'utf8')
    const file = relative(cwd, path)
    if (path.endsWith('.css')) {
      if (THEME_FILE.test(path)) continue
      // Mantis's own generated token block defines these variables; it does not read them.
      const body = text.replace(/\/\* @tokens:start \*\/[\s\S]*?\/\* @tokens:end \*\//g, (block) => block.replace(/[^\n]/g, ' '))
      for (const m of body.matchAll(SIZE_VAR)) {
        const before = body.slice(0, m.index)
        if (!seen.has(m[0])) seen.set(m[0], { file, line: before.split('\n').length, col: m.index - before.lastIndexOf('\n'), key: m[1], needs: `--size-${m[1]}:` })
      }
      continue
    }
    for (const c of extractCandidates(text)) {
      const m = c.base.match(SIZE_CLASS)
      if (m && !seen.has(c.base)) seen.set(c.base, { file, line: c.line, col: c.col, key: m[2], needs: `--${SIZE_FAMILIES[m[1]]}-${m[2]}:` })
    }
  }
  return seen
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ candidates
const COLOR_PREFIXES = new Set(['bg', 'text', 'border', 'ring', 'outline', 'fill', 'stroke', 'from', 'to', 'via', 'decoration', 'divide', 'placeholder', 'caret', 'accent', 'shadow'])
const SHIPPED = new Set(DATA.shipped)

// The utility after its variants: the segment after the last `:` that sits outside brackets,
// so `data-[state=open]:bg-x` and `has-[[aria-invalid=true]]:border-x` split correctly.
export function baseOf(token) {
  let depth = 0
  let cut = -1
  for (let i = 0; i < token.length; i++) {
    const ch = token[i]
    if (ch === '[' || ch === '(') depth++
    else if (ch === ']' || ch === ')') depth--
    else if (ch === ':' && depth === 0) cut = i
  }
  return token.slice(cut + 1).replace(/^!/, '').replace(/^-(?=[a-z])/, '')
}

// Every whitespace-separated token inside a string literal that looks like a utility (`prefix-something`).
// Template-literal holes become spaces so `${cond ? 'a' : 'b'}` never glues onto a class.
export function extractCandidates(text) {
  const out = []
  const lineStarts = [0]
  for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) if (text[i] === '\n') lineStarts.push(i + 1)
  const lineOf = (index) => {
    let lo = 0
    let hi = lineStarts.length - 1
    while (lo < hi) {
      const mid = (lo + hi + 1) >> 1
      if (lineStarts[mid] <= index) lo = mid
      else hi = mid - 1
    }
    return lo
  }
  for (const m of text.matchAll(/'([^'\n]*)'|"([^"\n]*)"|`([^`]*)`/g)) {
    const literal = (m[1] ?? m[2] ?? m[3]).replace(/\$\{[^}]*\}/g, (hole) => ' '.repeat(hole.length))
    const start = m.index + 1
    for (const t of literal.matchAll(/\S+/g)) {
      // prose punctuation glued to a class (`bg-card,`) is not part of it
      const token = t[0].replace(/[.,;:!?'"]+$/, '')
      if (!token) continue
      const base = baseOf(token)
      if (!/^[a-z]+(-[a-z]+)*-[a-z0-9([]/.test(base)) continue
      const index = start + t.index
      const line = lineOf(index)
      out.push({ token, base, line: line + 1, col: index - lineStarts[line] + 1 })
    }
  }
  return out
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ colour hints
const hex2rgb = (hex) => {
  const six = hex.length === 4 || hex.length === 5 ? hex.slice(1, 4).split('').map((c) => c + c).join('') : hex.slice(1, 7)
  return [0, 2, 4].map((i) => parseInt(six.slice(i, i + 2), 16))
}
const FALLBACK_HINT = 'see MANTIS.md › Tokens'
export function hexHint(value, prefix = 'bg') {
  if (!value.startsWith('#')) return `a token utility such as ${prefix}-background, ${prefix}-card, ${prefix}-muted-foreground or ${prefix}-brand (${FALLBACK_HINT})`
  const [r, g, b] = hex2rgb(value)
  const near = Object.entries(DATA.swatches)
    .map(([name, hex]) => { const [x, y, z] = hex2rgb(hex); return [name, (x - r) ** 2 + (y - g) ** 2 + (z - b) ** 2] })
    .sort((a, b) => a[1] - b[1])
    .slice(0, 2)
  return `nearest ${near.map(([name]) => `${prefix}-${name} (${DATA.swatches[name]})`).join(' or ')}`
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ rule: stock Tailwind palette
const HUE_GROUP = { white: 'white', black: 'black', slate: 'grey', gray: 'grey', zinc: 'grey', neutral: 'grey', stone: 'grey', red: 'red', rose: 'red', orange: 'none', amber: 'none', yellow: 'lime', lime: 'lime', green: 'green', emerald: 'green', teal: 'none', cyan: 'none', sky: 'blue', blue: 'blue', indigo: 'blue', violet: 'none', purple: 'none', fuchsia: 'pink', pink: 'pink' }
const PALETTE_FIX = {
  white: { text: 'text-foreground', bg: 'bg-primary (the white everyday button) or bg-glass (a see-through control)', border: 'border-glass-border', '*': 'foreground' },
  black: { text: 'text-primary-foreground (text on a white fill)', bg: 'bg-background (the page) or bg-overlay (a scrim)', '*': 'background' },
  grey: { text: 'text-muted-foreground (secondary text) or text-foreground', bg: 'bg-background (the page) or bg-card (a raised panel)', border: 'border-border', '*': 'muted-foreground' },
  red: { '*': 'destructive' },
  lime: { text: 'text-brand-text', '*': 'brand (lime marks the one main call to action on a screen)' },
  green: { '*': 'success' },
  blue: { '*': 'commerce-blue (offers and best-value tags only)' },
  pink: { '*': 'commerce-pink (sales and discount tags only)' },
}
export function paletteRule(base) {
  const m = base.match(/^([a-z]+)-(?:([a-z]+)-(?:50|[1-9]00|950)|(white|black))(?:\/.+)?$/)
  if (!m || !COLOR_PREFIXES.has(m[1])) return null
  const group = HUE_GROUP[m[2] ?? m[3]]
  if (!group) return null
  const prefix = m[1]
  const table = PALETTE_FIX[group]
  if (!table) return { rule: 'palette', fix: `→ Mantis has no role in this hue; pick a token utility (${FALLBACK_HINT})` }
  const exact = table[prefix]
  return { rule: 'palette', fix: `→ ${exact ?? `${prefix}-${table['*']}`}` }
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ Mantis's scales
// Every measured value an app writes should be a Mantis step. These tables say which steps
// exist (in pixels) and how each is written as a class, in CSS, or in a style prop.
const SPACE = { 0: 0, ...DATA.spacing }
const SCALES = {
  space: { table: SPACE, theme: 'spacing', label: 'spacing steps' },
  size: { table: SPACE, theme: 'spacing', label: 'spacing steps' },
  border: { table: DATA.borders, theme: 'border-width', label: 'border widths' },
  leading: { table: DATA.leading, theme: 'leading', label: 'line heights' },
  weight: { table: DATA.weights, theme: 'font-weight', label: 'weights' },
  text: { table: DATA.text, theme: 'text', label: 'type sizes' },
  radius: { table: DATA.radius, theme: 'radius', label: 'radius steps' },
}
const MAX_SPACE = Math.max(...Object.values(SPACE))
const SPACE_PREFIXES = new Set(['p', 'px', 'py', 'pt', 'pr', 'pb', 'pl', 'ps', 'pe', 'm', 'mx', 'my', 'mt', 'mr', 'mb', 'ml', 'ms', 'me', 'gap', 'gap-x', 'gap-y', 'space-x', 'space-y', 'inset', 'inset-x', 'inset-y', 'top', 'right', 'bottom', 'left', 'start', 'end', 'translate-x', 'translate-y'])
const SIZE_PREFIXES = new Set(['w', 'h', 'size', 'min-w', 'max-w', 'min-h', 'max-h', 'basis'])
const BORDER_PREFIX = /^(?:border(?:-[xytrblse])?|divide-[xy]|ring|outline)$/
const kindOfPrefix = (prefix) =>
  SPACE_PREFIXES.has(prefix) || /^scroll-[mp][xytrblse]?$/.test(prefix) ? 'space'
    : SIZE_PREFIXES.has(prefix) ? 'size'
      : BORDER_PREFIX.test(prefix) ? 'border'
        : prefix === 'leading' ? 'leading'
          : prefix === 'text' ? 'text'
            : prefix === 'rounded' || prefix.startsWith('rounded-') ? 'radius'
              : null

// The steps nearest a value: one, or the two either side when it sits exactly between them.
export function nearestSteps(kind, value) {
  const ranked = Object.entries(SCALES[kind].table).map(([key, v]) => [key, v, Math.abs(v - value)]).sort((a, b) => a[2] - b[2] || a[1] - b[1])
  return ranked.filter((step) => step[2] === ranked[0][2]).slice(0, 2).map(([key, v]) => [key, v])
}
const unit = (kind) => (kind === 'weight' ? '' : 'px')
const stepList = (kind) => Object.entries(SCALES[kind].table).sort((a, b) => a[1] - b[1]).map(([key, v]) => `${key} ${v}${unit(kind)}`).join(' · ')
// How a step is written: `p-3`, `border` (the bare utility is 1px), `--theme(--spacing-3)`.
const asClass = (prefix, key, kind) => (kind === 'border' && key === '1' ? prefix : kind === 'weight' ? `font-${key}` : `${prefix}-${key}`)
const asTheme = (kind, key) => `--theme(--${SCALES[kind].theme}-${String(key).replace('.', '_')})`

// Size tokens exist only as w-, h-, size-, min-w-, min-h- and max-h- classes and as --size-* variables,
// so max-w-, basis- and per-side spacing never get one. Returns how to write a token, or null.
const sizeWriter = (write) => {
  const probe = write('@key')
  if (probe === asTheme('size', '@key')) return (key) => `var(--size-${key})`
  return /^(?:className=")?(?:w|h|size|min-w|min-h|max-h)-@key"?$/.test(probe) ? write : null
}
// The nearest steps, written the way the author types them: `p-3 (12px) or p-4 (16px)`. A size
// that equals a named size token gets the token instead: it says what the size is for.
const stepNames = (kind, value, write, negative = false) => {
  const named = kind === 'size' && !negative ? sizeWriter(write) : null
  const tokens = named ? Object.entries(DATA.sizes).filter(([, px]) => px === value) : []
  if (tokens.length) return tokens.map(([key, px]) => `${named(key)} (${px}px)`).join(' or ')
  return nearestSteps(kind, value).map(([key, v]) => `${negative ? '-' : ''}${write(key)} (${v}${unit(kind)})`).join(' or ')
}
const scaleTail = (kind) => (kind === 'size' ? `, or the component's size prop; the ${SCALES.size.label}: ${stepList('size')}` : `; the ${SCALES[kind].label}: ${stepList(kind)}`)
const TOO_BIG = () => `→ the component's size prop, or let the layout size it (w-full, flex-1, grid columns): Mantis has no size step above ${MAX_SPACE}px`

// The fix for a measured value of one kind. `write` turns a step key into what the author types.
function stepFix(kind, value, write, { negative = false } = {}) {
  if (kind === 'size' && value > MAX_SPACE) return TOO_BIG()
  return `→ ${stepNames(kind, value, write, negative)}${scaleTail(kind)}`
}
const SHADOW_FIX = (as = 'class') => `→ a Mantis shadow: ${DATA.shadows.map((name) => (as === 'css' ? `var(--shadow-${name})` : `shadow-${name}`)).join(' · ')}`
const TRACKING_FIX = () => `→ a type style that carries Mantis's tracking (${DATA.textStyles.map((name) => `text-${name}`).join(' · ')}), or leave tracking at its default: Mantis has no tracking scale for running text`
// A stock line-height ratio has no fixed size; show what it comes to on text-sm, the body size.
const ratioFix = (ratio) => {
  const body = DATA.text.sm
  const [[key, v]] = nearestSteps('leading', ratio * body)
  return `→ the leading-* step for your font size (on text-sm, ${ratio} is leading-${key}, ${v}px); the ${SCALES.leading.label}: ${stepList('leading')}`
}

// A length in pixels, or null: px and rem (at 16px) only; em and % depend on the element.
const toPx = (text) => {
  const m = String(text).trim().match(/^(-?\d*\.?\d+)(px|rem)$/)
  return m ? Math.round(Number(m[1]) * (m[2] === 'rem' ? 16 : 1) * 1000) / 1000 : null
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ rule: bracket values
// Returns a finding, 'layout' (a bracket size this check does not judge, such as calc() or %) or null.
export function bracketRule(base, { shipped = false } = {}) {
  const m = base.match(/^([a-z]+(?:-[a-z]+)*)-\[(.+)\]$/)
  if (!m) return null
  const [, prefix, inner] = m
  if (/^(#|rgba?\(|hsla?\(|oklch\(|oklab\()/.test(inner)) return { rule: 'bracket', fix: `→ ${hexHint(inner, COLOR_PREFIXES.has(prefix) ? prefix : 'bg')}` }
  // Mantis's own blocks hold the reference's measured values; an app's code uses the scale.
  if (shipped) return 'layout'
  if (prefix === 'shadow') return { rule: 'bracket', fix: SHADOW_FIX() }
  if (prefix === 'tracking') return { rule: 'bracket', fix: TRACKING_FIX() }
  if (prefix === 'font' && /^[1-9]\d\d$/.test(inner)) return { rule: 'bracket', fix: stepFix('weight', Number(inner), (key) => `font-${key}`) }
  if (prefix === 'leading' && /^\d*\.?\d+$/.test(inner)) return { rule: 'bracket', fix: ratioFix(Number(inner)) }
  const value = toPx(inner)
  if (value === null) return 'layout'
  if (prefix === 'backdrop-blur') return { rule: 'bracket', fix: `→ backdrop-blur-${nearest(DATA.blurs, value)} (${DATA.blurs[nearest(DATA.blurs, value)]}px)` }
  const kind = kindOfPrefix(prefix)
  if (!kind) return { rule: 'bracket', fix: `→ a Mantis step or a component size prop in place of an exact value (${FALLBACK_HINT})` }
  return { rule: 'bracket', fix: stepFix(kind, Math.abs(value), (key) => asClass(prefix, key, kind), { negative: value < 0 }) }
}
const nearest = (table, value) => Object.entries(table).map(([name, n]) => [name, Math.abs(n - value)]).sort((a, b) => a[1] - b[1])[0][0]

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ rule: Tailwind steps Mantis does not have
// p-13, w-105, border-4, leading-11: Tailwind generates any number, Mantis names a few.
export function offScaleRule(base) {
  const m = base.match(/^([a-z]+(?:-[a-z]+)*)-(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)$/)
  if (!m) return null
  const [, prefix, step] = m
  const kind = kindOfPrefix(prefix)
  if (!kind || kind === 'text' || kind === 'radius') return null
  if (step in SCALES[kind].table) return null
  // A spacing step is 4px (space-100); a border step is its pixel width.
  const value = Number(step) * (kind === 'border' ? 1 : 4)
  return { rule: 'scale', fix: stepFix(kind, value, (key) => asClass(prefix, key, kind)) }
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ rule: Tailwind's own named values
// leading-normal, tracking-wide, font-light: they read Tailwind's theme, not Mantis's.
const STOCK_LEADING = { none: 1, tight: 1.25, snug: 1.375, normal: 1.5, relaxed: 1.625, loose: 2 }
const STOCK_WEIGHT = { thin: 100, extralight: 200, light: 300, extrabold: 800 }
export function stockRule(base) {
  const leading = base.match(/^leading-([a-z]+)$/)
  if (leading && leading[1] in STOCK_LEADING) return { rule: 'scale', fix: ratioFix(STOCK_LEADING[leading[1]]) }
  if (/^tracking-(tighter|tight|normal|wide|wider|widest)$/.test(base)) return { rule: 'scale', fix: TRACKING_FIX() }
  const weight = base.match(/^font-([a-z]+)$/)
  if (weight && weight[1] in STOCK_WEIGHT) return { rule: 'scale', fix: stepFix('weight', STOCK_WEIGHT[weight[1]], (key) => `font-${key}`) }
  return null
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ measured values outside classes
// One table for style props and CSS: the property (kebab-case), what it measures, and its class prefix.
const SIDES = { top: 't', right: 'r', bottom: 'b', left: 'l', inline: 'x', block: 'y', 'inline-start': 's', 'inline-end': 'e' }
const PROPERTIES = new Map([
  ...['padding', 'margin'].flatMap((p) => [[p, ['space', p[0]]], ...Object.entries(SIDES).map(([side, s]) => [`${p}-${side}`, ['space', p[0] + s]])]),
  ['gap', ['space', 'gap']], ['row-gap', ['space', 'gap-y']], ['column-gap', ['space', 'gap-x']],
  ['top', ['space', 'top']], ['right', ['space', 'right']], ['bottom', ['space', 'bottom']], ['left', ['space', 'left']],
  ['inset', ['space', 'inset']], ['inset-inline', ['space', 'inset-x']], ['inset-block', ['space', 'inset-y']],
  ['width', ['size', 'w']], ['height', ['size', 'h']], ['min-width', ['size', 'min-w']], ['max-width', ['size', 'max-w']],
  ['min-height', ['size', 'min-h']], ['max-height', ['size', 'max-h']], ['flex-basis', ['size', 'basis']],
  ['border-radius', ['radius', 'rounded']],
  ...[['top-left', 'tl'], ['top-right', 'tr'], ['bottom-right', 'br'], ['bottom-left', 'bl']].map(([corner, c]) => [`border-${corner}-radius`, ['radius', `rounded-${c}`]]),
  ['font-size', ['text', 'text']],
  ['border-width', ['border', 'border']], ['outline-width', ['border', 'outline']],
  ...Object.entries(SIDES).map(([side, s]) => [`border-${side}-width`, ['border', `border-${s}`]]),
  // Shorthands: only their width is judged (the colour is the raw-colour rule's).
  ['border', ['border', 'border']], ['outline', ['border', 'outline']],
  ...Object.entries(SIDES).map(([side, s]) => [`border-${side}`, ['border', `border-${s}`]]),
  ['line-height', ['leading', 'leading']], ['font-weight', ['weight', 'font']],
  ['letter-spacing', ['tracking', 'tracking']], ['box-shadow', ['shadow', 'shadow']],
])
// React adds px to a bare number, except on these.
const UNITLESS = new Set(['line-height', 'font-weight'])

// The finding for one property and value, or null. `as` is 'class' (a style prop) or 'css'.
export function valueRule(property, value, as) {
  const entry = PROPERTIES.get(property)
  if (!entry) return null
  const [kind, prefix] = entry
  const text = String(value).trim()
  if (!text || /^(inherit|initial|unset|none|auto|normal|0)$/.test(text)) return null
  // A token read is fine; a raw length beside one (border: 3px solid var(--border)) is still judged.
  const readsToken = /var\(|--theme\(|--spacing\(/.test(text)
  const rule = as === 'css' ? 'css-value' : 'inline-style'
  const write = (key) => (as === 'css' ? asTheme(kind, key) : `className="${asClass(prefix, key, kind)}"`)
  if (kind === 'shadow') return readsToken ? null : { rule, fix: SHADOW_FIX(as) }
  if (kind === 'tracking') return readsToken || toPx(text) === 0 ? null : { rule, fix: TRACKING_FIX() }
  if (kind === 'weight') return /^[1-9]\d\d$/.test(text) ? { rule, fix: stepFix('weight', Number(text), write) } : null
  if (kind === 'leading' && /^\d*\.?\d+$/.test(text)) return { rule, fix: ratioFix(Number(text)) }
  // A bare number in a style prop is pixels; every length in a value is judged on its own.
  const lengths = typeof value === 'number' ? [value] : [...text.matchAll(/(?<![\w.#-])-?\d*\.?\d+(?:px|rem)\b/g)].map((l) => toPx(l[0]))
  const judged = lengths.filter((n) => n !== null && n !== 0)
  if (!judged.length) return null
  if (judged.length === 1) return { rule, fix: stepFix(kind, Math.abs(judged[0]), write, { negative: judged[0] < 0 }) }
  // A shorthand such as padding: 8px 12px. In CSS the steps keep the shorthand's order; as
  // classes each length gets its own side (py-2 px-3), the way CSS reads two, three or four values.
  const sides = { 2: ['y', 'x'], 3: ['t', 'x', 'b'], 4: ['t', 'r', 'b', 'l'] }[judged.length]
  const perSide = as === 'class' && kind === 'space' && (prefix === 'p' || prefix === 'm') && sides && judged.length === lengths.length
  const each = judged.map((n, i) => {
    if (kind === 'size' && Math.abs(n) > MAX_SPACE) return `${n}px has no step`
    return stepNames(kind, Math.abs(n), perSide ? (key) => `className="${prefix}${sides[i]}-${key}"` : write, n < 0)
  })
  return { rule, fix: `→ ${each.join(perSide ? ' with ' : ', then ')}${scaleTail(kind)}` }
}

// Every hard-coded value in a JSX `style={{ … }}` block. Objects built elsewhere are not traced.
export function styleFindings(text) {
  const out = []
  const lineAt = (index) => text.slice(0, index).split('\n').length
  const colAt = (index) => index - text.lastIndexOf('\n', index - 1)
  for (const open of text.matchAll(/style=\{\{/g)) {
    let depth = 0
    let end = open.index + 6
    for (; end < text.length; end++) {
      if (text[end] === '{') depth++
      else if (text[end] === '}' && --depth === 0) break
    }
    const body = text.slice(open.index + 7, end)
    for (const m of body.matchAll(/([A-Za-z]+)\s*:\s*(-?\d*\.?\d+(?![\w.])|'[^'\n]*'|"[^"\n]*")/g)) {
      const property = m[1].replace(/[A-Z]/g, (c) => `-${c.toLowerCase()}`)
      const raw = m[2]
      const quoted = /^['"]/.test(raw)
      const value = quoted ? raw.slice(1, -1) : UNITLESS.has(property) ? raw : Number(raw)
      const hit = valueRule(property, value, 'class')
      if (!hit) continue
      const index = open.index + 7 + m.index
      out.push({ line: lineAt(index), col: colAt(index), rule: hit.rule, value: `${m[1]}: ${raw}`, fix: hit.fix })
    }
  }
  return out
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ rule: motion and blur
const STOCK_BLUR = { sm: 8, md: 12, lg: 16, xl: 24, '2xl': 40, '3xl': 64 }
export function motionRule(base) {
  const duration = base.match(/^duration-([0-9]+)$/)
  if (duration) {
    const name = nearest(DATA.durations, Number(duration[1]))
    return { rule: 'motion', fix: `→ duration-(--duration-${name}) (${DATA.durations[name]}ms); the steps: ${Object.entries(DATA.durations).map(([k, v]) => `${k} ${v}ms`).join(' · ')}` }
  }
  const blur = base.match(/^backdrop-blur-(sm|md|lg|xl|2xl|3xl)$/)
  if (blur) {
    const name = nearest(DATA.blurs, STOCK_BLUR[blur[1]])
    return { rule: 'motion', fix: `→ backdrop-blur-${name} (${DATA.blurs[name]}px); the steps: ${Object.entries(DATA.blurs).map(([k, v]) => `${k} ${v}px`).join(' · ')}` }
  }
  return null
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ rules read from whole lines
// A hex inside a bracket utility (bg-[#fff]) is the bracket rule's finding, not a second one: `[` is in the lookbehind.
const HEX_RE = /(?<![\w&#[-])#(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{8}|[0-9a-fA-F]{6}|[0-9a-fA-F]{3,4})(?![\w-])/g
const FN_RE = /(?<![\w[-])(?:rgba?|hsla?|oklch|oklab)\([^)]*\)/g
const NOT_COLOUR_ATTR = /(?:href|to|id|htmlFor|key|name|aria-[a-z]+|data-[a-z-]+)=["'{`]?$/
const LINE_RULES = [
  { rule: 'source-token', re: /--mantis-[a-z0-9-]+/g, fix: () => '→ --mantis-* is the source layer; read a semantic token or alias instead (--background, --primary, --brand… in MANTIS.md › Tokens)' },
  { rule: 'radix', re: /\basChild\b/g, fix: () => '→ Mantis is built on Base UI: compose with render={<Button />}, not asChild' },
  { rule: 'radix', re: /@radix-ui\/[a-z-]+/g, fix: () => '→ Mantis is built on Base UI (@base-ui/react), not Radix; use the Mantis component from @/components/ui' },
  { rule: 'radix', re: /\bnativeButton\b/g, fix: () => '→ a link that looks like a button is <a className={buttonVariants({…})}>; Button with render={<a>} is announced as a button' },
  { rule: 'icon-set', re: /(?<=from\s+['"])lucide-react(?=['"])/g, fix: () => "→ Mantis icons are Material Symbols: import { Icon } from '@/components/ui/icon' and write <Icon name=\"close\" />" },
]

export function lineFindings(lines) {
  const out = []
  lines.forEach((text, i) => {
    for (const re of [HEX_RE, FN_RE]) {
      for (const m of text.matchAll(re)) {
        if (NOT_COLOUR_ATTR.test(text.slice(Math.max(0, m.index - 12), m.index))) continue
        out.push({ line: i + 1, col: m.index + 1, rule: 'raw-color', value: m[0], fix: `→ a token utility in className, or var(--token) if a style prop is unavoidable — ${hexHint(m[0])}; a brand mark takes \`// mantis-check: allow raw-color — <why>\` on the line above` })
      }
    }
    for (const { rule, re, fix } of LINE_RULES) {
      for (const m of text.matchAll(re)) out.push({ line: i + 1, col: m.index + 1, rule, value: m[0], fix: fix(m) })
    }
  })
  return out
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ allows
// `mantis-check: allow <rule> — <why>`. On the same line it covers that line; on a line of its
// own it covers the element that follows, up to the line that closes the tag. The reason is
// mandatory: an allow without one is itself a finding, so exceptions never go quiet.
const ALLOW_RE = /mantis-check:\s*allow\s+([a-z-]+)(?:\s*[—–-]+\s*(.*?))?\s*(?:\*\/|-->|\}|$)/
const ALLOW_ONLY_LINE = /^\s*(?:\{\/\*|\/\/|\/\*|<!--)\s*mantis-check:/
// In CSS an allow on its own line covers the declaration below it, not the rest of the rule.
export function allowsFor(lines, lineNo, { css = false } = {}) {
  const found = []
  const same = lines[lineNo - 1]?.match(ALLOW_RE)
  if (same) found.push({ rule: same[1], reason: (same[2] ?? '').trim(), line: lineNo })
  for (let l = lineNo - 1; l >= 1 && l >= lineNo - 12; l--) {
    const text = lines[l - 1]
    if (ALLOW_ONLY_LINE.test(text)) { const m = text.match(ALLOW_RE); if (m) found.push({ rule: m[1], reason: (m[2] ?? '').trim(), line: l }); break }
    if (/>\s*$/.test(text)) break // a tag closed between: the allow above belongs to that element
    if (css && /[;{}]\s*$/.test(text)) break // another declaration or rule sits between
  }
  return found
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ one class
// The finding for one utility, 'layout' (a size this check does not judge) or null. Mantis's own
// blocks hold the reference's measured values, so only colour and motion rules apply to them.
function classFinding(base, shipped) {
  const hit = paletteRule(base) ?? motionRule(base) ?? (shipped ? null : stockRule(base) ?? offScaleRule(base))
  return hit ?? bracketRule(base, { shipped })
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ stylesheets
// The theme file is Mantis's own, and so is the block build-tokens writes between the @tokens markers.
const THEME_FILE = /(^|[\\/])mantis-theme\.css$/
export function cssFindings(text, { shipped = false } = {}) {
  const out = []
  const raw = text.split('\n')
  // Comments become spaces, so columns and line numbers still match the file.
  const lines = text.replace(/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g, (c) => c.replace(/[^\n]/g, ' ')).split('\n')
  let generated = false
  lines.forEach((line, i) => {
    if (raw[i].includes('@tokens:start')) generated = true
    if (raw[i].includes('@tokens:end')) generated = false
    if (generated) return
    const at = (index) => ({ line: i + 1, col: index + 1 })
    for (const m of line.matchAll(/--mantis-[a-z0-9-]+/g)) out.push({ ...at(m.index), rule: 'source-token', value: m[0], fix: '→ --mantis-* is the source layer; read a semantic token or alias instead (--background, --primary, --brand… in MANTIS.md › Tokens)' })
    // @apply takes the same classes as className, so the same rules.
    const apply = line.match(/@apply\s+([^;}]+)/)
    if (apply) {
      for (const t of apply[1].matchAll(/\S+/g)) {
        const hit = classFinding(baseOf(t[0]), shipped)
        if (hit && hit !== 'layout') out.push({ ...at(apply.index + apply[0].indexOf(apply[1]) + t.index), rule: hit.rule, value: t[0], fix: hit.fix })
      }
    }
    // Declarations. A custom property (--x: …) is a definition, not a use: Mantis's install steps
    // keep the app's own --chart-* and --sidebar-* colours, and a definition's unit is unknown.
    for (const m of line.matchAll(/(?:^|[;{])\s*([a-z][a-z-]*)\s*:\s*([^;{}]+)/g)) {
      const [, property, value] = m
      const start = m.index + m[0].indexOf(property)
      for (const re of [HEX_RE, FN_RE]) {
        for (const c of value.matchAll(re)) out.push({ ...at(start), rule: 'raw-color', value: `${property}: ${c[0]}`, fix: `→ a token: var(--background), var(--card), var(--brand)… — ${hexHint(c[0])}` })
      }
      const hit = valueRule(property, value, 'css')
      if (hit) out.push({ ...at(start), rule: hit.rule, value: `${property}: ${value.trim()}`, fix: hit.fix })
    }
  })
  return out
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ one file
export function scanFile(file, text, { includeUi = false } = {}) {
  const lines = text.split('\n')
  const findings = []
  let layout = 0
  const shipped = !includeUi && SHIPPED.has(file.split(/[\\/]/).pop())
  const css = file.endsWith('.css')
  if (css && THEME_FILE.test(file)) return { findings, layout }
  if (css) for (const f of cssFindings(text, { shipped })) findings.push({ file, ...f })
  else {
    for (const c of extractCandidates(text)) {
      const hit = classFinding(c.base, shipped)
      if (hit === 'layout') layout++
      else if (hit) findings.push({ file, line: c.line, col: c.col, rule: hit.rule, value: c.token, fix: hit.fix })
    }
    if (!shipped) for (const f of styleFindings(text)) findings.push({ file, ...f })
    for (const f of lineFindings(lines)) findings.push({ file, ...f })
  }
  const seenAllow = new Set()
  for (const f of [...findings]) {
    for (const a of allowsFor(lines, f.line, { css })) {
      if (a.rule !== f.rule) continue
      if (a.reason) f.allowed = a.reason
      else if (!seenAllow.has(a.line)) {
        seenAllow.add(a.line)
        findings.push({ file, line: a.line, col: 1, rule: 'allow-without-reason', value: a.rule, fix: `→ write the reason after a dash: \`mantis-check: allow ${a.rule} — why this one is right\`` })
      }
    }
  }
  return { findings, layout }
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ the theme's wiring
const ENTRY_CANDIDATES = ['app/globals.css', 'src/app/globals.css', 'styles/globals.css', 'src/styles/globals.css']
const NOT_WIRED = '→ Mantis\'s theme is not wired into Tailwind here, so every token utility (bg-card, text-muted-foreground, bg-brand…) is dead. Add `@import "./mantis-theme.css";` beside the other @import rules at the top of this file'
const DARK_FIX = '→ nothing in Mantis applies a .dark class, so every dark: utility in the primitives is dead. Write `@custom-variant dark (&:where([data-theme="dark"], [data-theme="dark"] *));` and set data-theme="dark" on <html>'

export function checkEntry(cwd, css) {
  const findings = []
  const notes = []
  const entry = css ? resolve(cwd, css) : ENTRY_CANDIDATES.map((candidate) => join(cwd, candidate)).find((candidate) => existsSync(candidate))
  if (!entry || !existsSync(entry)) {
    notes.push(css ? `note: ${css} does not exist, so the theme's wiring was not checked` : 'note: no Tailwind entry stylesheet found (looked for app/globals.css and three others), so the theme\'s wiring was not checked; pass --css <entry>')
    return { findings, notes }
  }
  const lines = readFileSync(entry, 'utf8').split('\n')
  const file = relative(cwd, entry)
  if (!lines.some((line) => /@import\s+["'][^"']*mantis-theme\.css["']/.test(line))) findings.push({ file, line: 1, col: 1, rule: 'unresolved', value: 'mantis-theme.css', fix: NOT_WIRED })
  const stock = lines.findIndex((line) => /@custom-variant\s+dark\s*\(\s*&:is\(\s*\.dark\b/.test(line))
  if (stock >= 0) findings.push({ file, line: stock + 1, col: 1, rule: 'dark-variant', value: '@custom-variant dark', fix: DARK_FIX })
  const sizes = sizeClassesIn(cwd)
  const themeImport = lines.map((line) => line.match(/@import\s+["']([^"']*mantis-theme\.css)["']/)).find(Boolean)
  if (sizes.size && themeImport) {
    // Only a relative import is followed; an alias or package path is reported as unchecked rather than guessed.
    const themePath = resolve(dirname(entry), themeImport[1])
    if (!existsSync(themePath)) notes.push(`note: could not read ${themeImport[1]} from ${file}, so the size tokens were not checked against the theme`)
    else {
      // One root cause, one finding: placed at the first use, naming every size the theme lacks.
      const theme = readFileSync(themePath, 'utf8')
      const missing = [...sizes].filter(([, at]) => !theme.includes(at.needs))
      if (missing.length) {
        const [first, at] = missing[0]
        const names = missing.map(([name]) => name).join(', ')
        findings.push({ file: at.file, line: at.line, col: at.col, rule: 'unresolved', value: first, fix: `→ the app's mantis-theme.css predates the size tokens, so ${names} ${missing.length === 1 ? 'has' : 'have'} no CSS; reinstall the theme: npx shadcn@latest add @mantis/base --overwrite (this also replaces the installed primitives, mantis-cn and MANTIS.md with the current ones)` })
      }
    }
  }
  // The same gap in the class-merge helper: an older mantis-cn does not know the size names, so a size
  // passed to a component (className="h-12") sits beside the component's own and the stylesheet picks one.
  const helper = sizes.size ? listFiles(cwd, { includeUi: true }).find((path) => /(^|[\\/])mantis-cn\.[jt]sx?$/.test(path)) : null
  if (helper) {
    const source = readFileSync(helper, 'utf8')
    const missing = [...new Set([...sizes.values()].map((at) => at.key))].filter((key) => !source.includes(`"${key}"`) && !source.includes(`'${key}'`))
    if (missing.length) findings.push({ file: relative(cwd, helper), line: 1, col: 1, rule: 'unresolved', value: 'mantis-cn', fix: `→ this mantis-cn predates the size tokens (${missing.join(', ')}), so a size passed to a component does not replace its own; reinstall it: npx shadcn@latest add @mantis/mantis-cn --overwrite` })
  }
  return { findings, notes }
}

export async function runCheck({ cwd = process.cwd(), dirs, includeUi = false, css } = {}) {
  const findings = []
  let layout = 0
  for (const path of listFiles(cwd, { dirs: dirs ?? [cwd], includeUi })) {
    const result = scanFile(relative(cwd, path), readFileSync(path, 'utf8'), { includeUi })
    findings.push(...result.findings)
    layout += result.layout
  }
  const entry = checkEntry(cwd, css)
  findings.push(...entry.findings)
  findings.sort((a, b) => (a.file < b.file ? -1 : a.file > b.file ? 1 : a.line - b.line || a.col - b.col))
  return { findings, layout, notes: entry.notes }
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ output
// Labels and ids match quill-check's, so the Quill CLI shows both systems' findings the same way.
const RULE_LABEL = { scale: 'off scale', 'inline-style': 'inline style', 'css-value': 'css value', unresolved: 'unresolved', palette: 'palette', 'raw-color': 'raw colour', bracket: 'bracket', 'dark-variant': 'dark:', 'allow-without-reason': 'allow', 'source-token': 'source tok', motion: 'motion', radix: 'radix', 'icon-set': 'icon set' }

export function formatText({ findings, layout, notes }, { quiet = false } = {}) {
  const lines = []
  const active = findings.filter((f) => !f.allowed)
  if (!quiet) {
    let current = null
    for (const f of findings) {
      if (f.file !== current) {
        current = f.file
        if (lines.length) lines.push('')
        lines.push(f.file)
      }
      lines.push(`  ${String(f.line).padStart(4)}  ${f.value.padEnd(28)}  ${RULE_LABEL[f.rule].padEnd(12)}  ${f.allowed ? `allowed — ${f.allowed}` : f.fix}`)
    }
    if (lines.length) lines.push('')
  }
  lines.push(`${active.length} finding${active.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} · ${findings.length - active.length} allowed · ${layout} layout size${layout === 1 ? '' : 's'} not checked`)
  for (const note of notes) lines.push(note)
  return lines.join('\n')
}

export async function main(argv = process.argv.slice(2)) {
  const opts = { dirs: [], includeUi: false, json: false, quiet: false, css: undefined }
  for (let i = 0; i < argv.length; i++) {
    const a = argv[i]
    if (a === '--dir') opts.dirs.push(resolve(process.cwd(), argv[++i]))
    else if (a === '--css') opts.css = argv[++i]
    else if (a === '--include-ui') opts.includeUi = true
    else if (a === '--json') opts.json = true
    else if (a === '--quiet') opts.quiet = true
    else if (a === '--help' || a === '-h') {
      console.log(`mantis-check ${DATA.version}\n  node scripts/mantis-check.mjs [--dir <path>]... [--css <tailwind entry>] [--include-ui] [--json] [--quiet]\n  Lists every place the code stepped outside Mantis, with the fix to write. Exit 1 when anything is found.`)
      return 0
    } else {
      console.error(`unknown option ${a} — try --help`)
      return 2
    }
  }
  const result = await runCheck({ cwd: process.cwd(), dirs: opts.dirs.length ? opts.dirs : undefined, includeUi: opts.includeUi, css: opts.css })
  const active = result.findings.filter((f) => !f.allowed).length
  if (opts.json) console.log(JSON.stringify({ version: DATA.version, summary: { findings: active, allowed: result.findings.length - active, layout: result.layout, notes: result.notes }, findings: result.findings }, null, 1))
  else console.log(formatText(result, { quiet: opts.quiet }))
  return active ? 1 : 0
}

// Compared as real file paths: run through a symlink (a macOS temp folder is one), argv[1] and
// import.meta.url name different paths, and a string comparison would skip main() and exit 0 having
// checked nothing.
function isMain() {
  if (!process.argv[1]) return false
  try { return realpathSync(process.argv[1]) === realpathSync(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)) } catch { return false }
}

// exitCode, not exit(): on macOS a pipe is asynchronous, and exit() can drop the tail of a long
// --json report, which the tool reading it sees as broken JSON.
if (isMain()) process.exitCode = await main()

docs: Installed to scripts/mantis-check.mjs. Run `node scripts/mantis-check.mjs` from the app root after every UI change and clear every finding; `--json` for tools, `--dir <path>` to narrow, `--include-ui` to also scan the installed primitives and Mantis's own blocks, `--css <entry>` if the Tailwind entry is not app/globals.css, `--quiet` for the summary line only. Exit code 1 means something was found. A deliberate exception takes a comment with a reason: `// mantis-check: allow raw-color — the partner's logo color`. Re-run `npx shadcn@latest add @mantis/check --overwrite` after each Mantis release.
